name: Uldin
source:
A charismatic man whose family rose to power through slightly sinister means. He claims that his brothers are all military men, but he's more academically gifted and trained in the studies of magic and strategy.

Uses he/him pronouns.
Likes: Furthering his knowledge and friendly debates.
Dislikes: Hotheads who talk without thinking.
